in_sanskrit.name: Ezhumalai
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of the forest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ezhumalai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ezhumalai means 'Goddess of the forest' in the Tamil language. This name is derived from the words 'Ezhu' meaning 'forest' and 'Malai' meaning 'hill' or 'goddess'. In Hindu mythology, Ezhumalai is considered to be a manifestation of the goddess Mariamman, who is worshipped in the forests and is believed to protect the people from diseases and calamities.
